plan: AIya Performance Plan 1 - Valid Measurement and Root Cause Evidence
phase: 1 - Source, finding, and closure contract lock

findingStatusDefinitions.PENDING_VALID_AUTHENTICATED_REPRODUCTION: Static or historical candidate; no runtime change is authorized.
findingStatusDefinitions.MEASUREMENT_GAP_CONFIRMED: The measurement contract is incomplete or invalid; this is not a runtime performance root cause.
findingStatusDefinitions.MEASURED_CANDIDATE_PENDING_VALID_AUTHENT: A prior failure exists, but valid real-auth reproduction and exact code attribution are still required.
findingStatusDefinitions.CAUSE_CONFIRMED: At least three matching valid samples/traces and a controlled single-variable causal result identify the cause and exact code path.
findingStatusDefinitions.CONTRIBUTING_FACTOR_CONFIRMED: A repeatable contributor is measured but does not independently meet the primary cause threshold.
findingStatusDefinitions.NOT_REPRODUCED: Valid required samples do not reproduce the candidate behavior.
findingStatusDefinitions.OPEN_BLOCKED: Required evidence or environment is unavailable.

findings.causalExperiment: Compare small, normal, and scale fixture volumes while keeping build, device, network, session, and route action fixed; compare app-state request fanout, body-finish, parse, render, and task-ready.
findings.closureEvidence: Three or more matching valid samples/traces tie broad app-state hydration to the missed task budget and identify the exact loader/consumer path.
findings.plan2Eligibility: Only when CAUSE_CONFIRMED or a measured contributing factor is recorded.

findings.causalExperiment: Compare natural background refresh with a diagnostic pause after initial readiness while keeping the same authenticated route, fixture, device, network, and user action; record overlapping requests, request count, long tasks, and task-ready.
findings.closureEvidence: Three or more matching valid samples/traces show background refresh overlap and a repeatable task-ready or interaction delta without losing required freshness behavior.
findings.plan2Eligibility: Only when CAUSE_CONFIRMED or a measured contributing factor is recorded.

findings.causalExperiment: Compare main-thread parse/evaluate, long-task, layout, paint, and task-ready data across the unchanged eager import graph and measured panel-specific trace points; no speculative split is applied.
findings.closureEvidence: Three or more matching valid traces identify a heavy bundle/panel/render path and its contribution to the missed interaction or readiness budget.
findings.plan2Eligibility: Only when CAUSE_CONFIRMED or a measured contributing factor is recorded.

findings.causalExperiment: Run AI Chat with a real authenticated tenant/account/actor and require a 2xx conversation-list response plus ai-chat-workspace; compare auth failure, response completion, parse, and render as separate outcomes.
findings.closureEvidence: The measurement gap is resolved only when valid authenticated AI Chat samples have 2xx conversation-list reads and the required workspace selector; a 401 remains an auth/store failure.
findings.plan2Eligibility: Measurement-gap closure alone does not authorize a runtime speed fix.

findings.causalExperiment: Repeat the corrected warm-session AI Chat measurement on real auth/store paths and separate failed reads from task-ready, event-to-paint, and render timing.
findings.closureEvidence: At least three valid authenticated samples/traces identify whether the failure is auth, store, network, parse, render, or polling related and map it to exact files/functions.
findings.plan2Eligibility: Only after exact affected files/functions and causal evidence are recorded.
